notes: No article morpheme stands in the chain גפי מרמי קרת, so both English *the*s are supplied and are placed by rules 29 and 15 — the first before the outer construct's word, the second before the rectum's.

The split of *the highest* / *places* across גף and מרום is the reading taken; the competing fusion of the two height nouns under rule 30 is named in the unit's note, and is rejected because the ASV spends a word on each noun so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet.
